name: gauge-s-log-downloader
description: Native (Capacitor) build of the Gauge.S log downloader — talks to the device over the OS HTTP stack so DELETE works without a CORS preflight.

scripts.icons: node scripts/make-icons.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --android --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#6366f1' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#6366f1' --splashBackgroundColor '#0f1117' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0f1117' && node scripts/fix-adaptive-icon.mjs
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && cap run ios
